sv.title: Saudiarabien och Huthirörelsen utbyter attacker
sv.summary: Saudiarabien och den Iranstödda Huthimilisen i Jemen har utbytt attacker under den tidiga lördagen, uppger representanter för båda sidor.

en.title: Saudi Arabia and Houthi movement exchange attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen have exchanged attacks during the early hours of Saturday, representatives of both sides say.
